title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression gating and metric thresholds
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: prevent prompt-set regressions from reaching production by running lightweight evals and gating merges when core metrics regress beyond configured thresholds. This PR introduces a new CI hook (eval-harness/prompt-regression-check) that runs a small representative prompt-set on candidate builds, computes configured metrics (exact_match, rouge_l, embedding_cos_sim, hallucination_rate surrogate), and compares against baseline thresholds stored per-prompt-set. If any metric crosses its threshold the hook fails the CI and annotates the PR with the failing metric and example cases. Design: 1) a new pytest-based harness entrypoint (tests/eval_ci/test_prompt_gating.py) that loads prompt-sets referenced in eval-harness catalog, runs them in a constrained mode (max tokens=128, deterministic sampling), and emits a normalized JSON summary; 2) a lightweight comparator (tools/eval_ci/thresholds.py) that fetches baseline metrics from eval-harness/thresholds/, computes deltas, and applies per-metric policies (hard-fail, warn, or auto-approve for trivial deltas); 3) a GitHub Actions workflow (ci/eval-prompt-gating.yml) that parallelizes prompt-sets and posts check annotations; 4) small SDK changes to expose deterministic generation mode for CI. Checklist: - [x] implement pytest entrypoint and comparator - [x] add GH action and integrate with existing CI matrix - [x] add thresholds file for critical prompt-sets - [x] test on redwood/infra and redwood/eval-harness smoke examples - [x] add docs snippet on how to update thresholds and how to mark experimental sets as opt-in. Rollout: Enabled for core prompt-sets by default, experimental sets opt-in via thresholds metadata. Rollback: CI hook is non-blocking for release branches until opt-in flag flipped via release config. Related: ENG-4823, infra PR #272109 for deterministic generator API.

release_notes: Add CI gating for core prompt-set regressions: new GH Action 'eval-harness/prompt-regression-check' that runs representative prompt-sets and blocks merges when defined quality thresholds regress. See docs/eval-harness/ci-gating.md for how to update thresholds and opt-in experimental sets.
metrics_thresholds: exact_match: baseline per-prompt-set, hard-fail if drop > 2.0%
gating_behavior: Per-prompt-set comparator applies per-metric policy: hard-fail stops merge, warn leaves PR open and annotates, auto-approve allowed for experimental sets. Baselines are stored as versioned YAMLs in eval-harness/thresholds. Threshold updates require a PR to change baseline files and a changelog entry.
notes_for_release_engineering: This CI hook is enabled on main for core prompt-sets. For scheduled release branches the hook runs in warn-only mode until Release Engineering flips the flag in infra/release-config. Release engineers should coordinate threshold bumps with model rollouts.
example_annotations: [eval-harness] prompt-set 'core_qa' failed exact_match: baseline=78.4 current=75.9 delta=-2.5 (threshold=-2.0) See failed examples attached.
